title: 第9章 你怎么跪了？
slug: 修罗武帝全本免费-修罗武帝最新章节列表
content_zh:
似乎，对方说的倒是事实啊！
这，这该死的混账东西！
“你要多少钱？”
姜峰皱眉询问。
“来个一百块真元魂石，也就差不多了！”
姜辰随口说道。
“噗——”
姜峰差点吐血。
一百块真元魂石，对方还真敢开口啊！这差不多是他一年的零花钱了！
“我说了，先给我啊，不然就不去，反正我现在对家族也没啥感觉了。”
“姜辰，我就是给你，你有东西放吗？！”
“没东西放，就先将你的乾坤戒指解除烙印，借我用用呗，等我有了，再还你就是了。”
“你，你还真是敢开口啊！不过，我都答应你，但你必需跟我走！族长有重要的事情交代，我不与你多说！上来吧！”
姜峰的脸都有些扭曲，一身白色剑服长袍都不由簌簌作响了起来，显然是气的不轻。
而姜婷儿，则只是冷笑。
姜峰释放出了飞剑，御剑术施展出来，立刻飞剑变大了数倍。
同时，他将手中的银白色的戒指取下，魂力涌动，印记消失，直接的将其抛给了姜辰，道：“拿好了，东西都在里面，不过，等你有了乾坤戒指，就要还我！”
“好说好说。”
姜辰嘿嘿一笑，魂力暗自涌动，立刻将戒指戴在自己的手指上，并种下了灵魂烙印。
戒指里面，有大概是百个立方的大小，不算太大，但是比之他曾经的乾坤戒指，还要大几分。

里面的真元魂石，也有三百多块。
除了真元魂石，里面还有一柄玉色的古老飞剑，飞剑上有点点雕纹，暂时看不出名堂。
飞剑旁边，有一个古色古香的衣橱，衣橱里面，有着三套全新的白色长袍悬挂着，长袍上还有元气流淌，显然是全新没穿过的。
看样子，这姜峰得到的时间不长，自己也舍不得穿。
衣橱另外一个空间部分，则是两套儒白色的剑服长袍，虽然同样很新，却明显是穿过的。
姜辰魂力扫过，立刻非常满意。
里面的东西不多，却如给他量身打造的一样。姜辰觉得，姜峰如此上路，等会儿就小小的教训一下，打的他半年不能修炼好了。
姜辰很自然的踏上了飞剑，也没有表现出什么能力。
他的境界，炼化了血雾之后，真元境四重的姜韵都看不出半点端倪，所以姜辰不觉得姜峰这紫气境八重的修士可以看透。
他若可以看透，岂会想办法招惹自己？
姜辰站在飞剑上之后，姜峰脸上显出了扭曲之意。
他甚至已经想着，将今天的所有恨意全部爆发，将姜辰打得跪地求饶的场景了！
曾经，姜辰天赋异禀，什么都比他强，族中的少女，也都围着姜辰打转，反而是他姜峰，那么的努力，却始终不被待见。
姜辰废了之后，姜峰才逐渐的显出了天赋和能力，并得到了族中的部分少女的青睐。
如今，他也已经即将成为紫气境九重的先天武者，这，已经算是不错的实力了！
而且，他比姜辰小两岁，才十七岁！
三年前，姜辰十六岁，也才紫气境九重而已，却算是极为了得的天才！
姜峰想着，立刻驾驭飞剑，朝着苍山深处飞去。
姜婷儿，则驾驭飞剑，跟在了姜峰身后。
“我的戒指，就先放在你那放会儿，等会儿，让你跪着、双手捧着还给我！”

“我姜峰的东西，能那么好得？！”
姜峰心中冷笑。
很快，姜峰就带着姜辰来到了苍山深处。
这里，甚至于离着寒潭已经不远。
从飞剑上落下，姜峰也不隐藏，只是盯着姜辰冷笑。
姜婷儿，也同样如此。
“姜峰，族长有什么事情交代，现在没人了，可以说了。”
姜辰笑道。
“族长说，你这个小杂种，怎么还不死呢！”
姜峰说着，已经鼓荡起紫气，运转于拳中，朝着姜辰的脸，狠狠打了过去。
他身法迅捷，出手又近乎于是偷袭一样。
他打算一拳将姜辰的脸打肿，打的姜辰倒飞出去，跪地吐血。
只是，想的很好，这一幕却没有发生。
因为他一拳，直接打空了。
“拳？我记得，我对于拳法，还是很有研究的。”
姜辰说着，随意一拳打出，携带着一股凶兽的气势！
“嗡——”
空气的气流都发出了轻微的震颤声。
姜峰的拳打空了，而姜辰的拳却直接打中了姜峰的脸，并带起了劲气的声音。
“喀嚓——”

content_en:
It seems that what the other party said is true!
This, this damn bastard!
"How much do you want?"
Jiang Feng frowned and asked.
"One hundred True Essence Soul Stones will be enough!"
Jiang Chen said casually.
"Pfft——"
Jiang Feng almost vomited blood.
One hundred pieces of true soul stone, the other party really dared to speak! This is almost his pocket money for a year!
"I said, give it to me first, otherwise I won't go. Anyway, I don't have any feelings for the family now."
"Jiang Chen, I'm just giving it to you, do you have anything to put?!"
"If you don't have anything to put, just remove the brand from your Qiankun ring and lend it to me. When I have it, I'll return it to you."
"You, you really dare to speak! However, I promise you, but you must come with me! The clan leader has something important to explain, and I won't say more to you! Come up!"
Jiang Feng's face was a little distorted, and his white sword uniform and robe could not help but rustle. He was obviously very angry.
Jiang Ting'er, on the other hand, just sneered.
Jiang Feng released the flying sword, and when he used his sword control skills, the flying sword immediately grew several times larger.
At the same time, he took off the silver-white ring in his hand, his soul power surged, the mark disappeared, and he threw it directly to Jiang Chen, saying: "Take it, everything is inside, but when you have the Qiankun Ring, you must return it to me!"
"It's easy to talk about."
Jiang Chen chuckled, his soul power secretly surged, and he immediately put the ring on his finger and planted the soul mark.
Inside the ring, it is about a hundred cubic meters in size. It is not too big, but it is a bit larger than the Qiankun ring he once had.
There are more than three hundred true soul stones inside.
In addition to the True Essence Soul Stone, there is also an ancient jade-colored flying sword inside. There are some carvings on the flying sword, but it is not famous for the time being.
Next to Feijian, there is an antique wardrobe. Inside the wardrobe, there are three sets of brand new white robes hanging. There is vitality flowing on the robes. They are obviously brand new and have never been worn.
Apparently, Jiang Feng didn't get it for long, and he couldn't bear to wear it.
In another part of the wardrobe, there are two sets of Confucian white sword robes. Although they are also new, they are obviously worn.
Jiang Chen's soul power swept over and he was immediately very satisfied.
There weren't many things inside, but it looked like it was tailor-made for him. Jiang Chen felt that if Jiang Feng went on the road like this, he would give him a small lesson later and beat him to the point where he would not be able to practice for half a year.
Jiang Chen stepped onto the flying sword naturally without showing any ability.
After refining the blood mist, Jiang Yun, who is at the fourth level of the True Essence Realm, can't see any clues about his realm, so Jiang Chen doesn't think Jiang Feng, a monk at the eighth level of the Purple Qi Realm, can see through it.
If he could see through it, how could he think of ways to provoke him?
After Jiang Chen stood on the flying sword, Jiang Feng's face showed a twisted expression.
He was even thinking about the scene where he would burst out all his hatred today and beat Jiang Chen until he knelt down and begged for mercy!
Once upon a time, Jiang Chen was extremely talented and was better than him in everything. The girls in the clan also circled around Jiang Chen. On the contrary, it was Jiang Feng who worked so hard but was never welcomed.
After Jiang Chen was deposed, Jiang Feng gradually showed his talents and abilities, and gained the favor of some girls in the clan.
Now, he is about to become an innate warrior at the ninth level of the Purple Qi Realm. This is already considered a good strength!
Moreover, he is two years younger than Jiang Chen, only seventeen years old!
Three years ago, Jiang Chen was sixteen years old. He was only at the ninth level of the Purple Qi Realm, but he was considered an extremely talented person!
Jiang Feng thought, and immediately controlled the flying sword and flew towards the depths of Cangshan Mountain.
Jiang Ting'er, riding a flying sword, followed Jiang Feng.
"I'll put my ring with you for a while. Later, I'll have you kneel down and hold it in both hands and return it to me!"
"How can my Jiang Feng's things be so good?!"
Jiang Feng sneered in his heart.
Soon, Jiang Feng took Jiang Chen to the depths of Cangshan Mountain.Here, it is not far from Hantan.
After falling from the flying sword, Jiang Feng didn't hide, he just stared at Jiang Chen and sneered.
The same is true for Jiang Ting'er.
"Jiang Feng, the clan leader has something to explain. Now that there is no one around, you can do it."
Jiang Chen smiled.
"The patriarch said, you little bastard, why aren't you dead yet?"
As Jiang Feng spoke, he had already stirred up purple energy, which was flowing in his fist, and hit Jiang Chen hard in the face.
His movements are swift and his attacks are almost like sneak attacks.
He planned to swell Jiang Chen's face with one punch, causing Jiang Chen to fly backwards and kneel down to vomit blood.
However, I thought well, but this scene did not happen.
Because with one punch, he hit nothing.
"Boxing? I remember that I am very knowledgeable about boxing techniques."
Jiang Chen said, and punched out randomly, carrying the aura of a ferocious beast!
"Buzz——"
The air flow made a slight trembling sound.
Jiang Feng's punch was empty, but Jiang Chen's punch directly hit Jiang Feng's face, making a loud sound.
"Click——"
